  • new installation of Thunderbird without any profiles and fresh account confguration doesn't solve the problem
  • I can connect to our mail provider and send and receive mail when using my home network or my personal phone hotspot
  • I can connect to my private mail provider using Thunderbird while in the office network
  • troubleshooting mode doesn't solve the issue
  • renewing the internet connection on our router temporarily/once allowed some devices to receive mail

IMAP-Log returns the following error codes:

  • D/IMAP URL failed with code 0x804b000e
  • D/IMAP URL failed with code 0x804b001e

I would be glad if somebody could help me out. If you need any more details I'll provide them. Thanks in advance!

title: **Intermittent error when forwarding emails with attachments (IMAP, Windows 11)**
creator: tiitus.halonen.hq
content:
Hello,

I'm experiencing an intermittent issue when forwarding emails with attachments (large and small) in Thunderbird on Windows 11. The error message reads:

  • "Sending the message failed. An error occurred while attaching [filename]. Check that you have the right permissions to read the file."*

The issue is not consistent — the same message can often be forwarded successfully later (as in the next day).

    • Environment:**

- Thunderbird (latest version) - Windows 11 - IMAP account - Windows Defender active

    • What I have tried:**
    • Suspected root causes:**

- Windows Defender or other AV software briefly locking the temporary file while Thunderbird tries to read it during forwarding.

Has anyone else encountered this, and is there a more permanent fix? Is there a known bug related to this behavior?

Thank you.

Yet I know the same 90 emails are still sitting in the mail server system.
